According to information published by the Indian Machine Tool Manufacturers' Association (IMTMA), production turnover of the Indian machine-tool industry reached approximately 16,478 crore during FY 2025-26, representing growth of around 13% over FY 2024-25 and marking the industry's highest-ever production turnover.
